description: Sweep cron dispatches an optimization sweep scoped to Search; google-ads-agent claims, reads Google Ads API creds from the vault, pulls search-terms + bidding data via the API, ships reversible fixes (negatives + a creative pause), files the sweep as a routine ticket and completes with result + digest. Budget-raise opportunity is surfaced in the result, never executed.

args.result: Optimization sweep on Search campaigns shipped: 4 exact-match negatives added (wasted spend $38/wk), 1 fatigued RSA paused (CTR -41% over 14d). All changes reversible, within existing budget. Budget-raise opportunity: Brand Search is impression-share limited at 71% — raise filed as its own co-founder task.
args.digest: Ran google.optimize_account on Search. 4 negatives + 1 RSA pause shipped; CPA $42 vs target $45, on track. Brand Search budget-raise ask awaits co-founder. Next wake: verify the RSA pause didn't dent conversion volume.
